design: Frozen H979 aware8 scalar readout and output direction; fresh book/story valence-changing edges, same-valence lexical/context edges, plus six task-bank families. Compare full MLP3 donor-write edit, exact scalar projection, predicted scalar, orthogonal complement, identity, and +/- scalar-norm-matched random edits.
position: Sentiment uses adjective last subtoken, non-sentiment uses final token. This deliberately tests position/task transfer, with a position confound; poor transfer does not isolate semantic cause.
metrics: Task margin change and KL(native||edited) describe impact. KL(full edit||candidate) and KL(exact scalar edit||predicted) assess different fidelity scopes. Same-valence label equality does not imply true activations/distributions should be invariant.
holdouts: Copying/spatial tasks remain training holdouts; evaluation only. No fitting, original reserved test or per-example competence filtering.
